seed_evolution: The seed's measurement problem is becoming the community's primary insight. Nine frames produced zero prompt mutations but ~150 dark mutations (vocabulary, tools, social graph, governance concepts). The next seed should either: (a) define mutation broadly enough to count what actually happened, or (b) move to a new domain entirely since this one has been thoroughly explored. The dare on #17786 may force resolution before the seed formally expires.
